description: List the sittings (posiedzenia) of one committee in a term, oldest first, with date, time, room, status (PLANNED, FINISHED, CANCELLED) and agenda as plain text. Narrow the list with dateFrom and dateTo; get-committee-sitting returns one sitting with its video links.

cancelled.description: Also include cancelled sittings; defaults to false

code.description: Code of the committee (komisja), e.g. ASW or FPB: the `code` field from get-committees

dateFrom.description: Earliest sitting date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Latest sitting date, in YYYY-MM-DD format

limit.description: Maximum number of sittings to return after the date filter; all by default

offset.description: Number of sittings to skip after the date filter, for pagination; defaults to 0

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-committee-sittings

type.description: Kind of event, e.g. posiedzenie (plenary sitting) or komisja (committee)

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

title: List committee sittings
